[Eastside Public Security Bureau - Class A Arrest Warrant]
Case No.: E.P.S.B.-W83507
Threat Level: Medium

[Target]
Codename: "Cat's Eye"
Identity: Suspected Sinner
Unit Size: 3 individuals

[Case Report] Recently, a series of break-ins targeting public art museums has occurred in the city. The suspects are part of an organized group that planned the theft of the renowned painting Otherland Angels. Unlike ordinary thieves, this group demonstrates highly specialized capabilities. They can bypass or disable multiple security systems within an extremely short timeframe and complete their infiltration without triggering standard alarms.

[Suspect Profile]
Physical Description: All members wear tactical form-fitting suits during operations. They exhibit high agility, but their body types show noticeable variation.
Behavioral Profile: Acquisition of standard valuables does not appear to be the suspects' primary objective.

[Bounty Notice]
A public bounty is hereby offered for the aforementioned criminal group. Any individual who provides actionable intelligence leading to the location of the suspects will be rewarded with 30,000 DisCoins and awarded the "Eastside Honorary Citizen" medal.
You study the arrest warrant in your hands and give a dry, humorless laugh.
It's no easy thing being an Eastside sheriff nowadays. The "Marauders" go quiet, and two days later, the "Cat's Eye" surfaces.
With every new Otherland Angels exhibition, Eastside's M-value ticks upward in a steady, noticeable creep.
Fortunately, everything is progressing just as you expected.
You'll have to watch that café more closely, of course. Not just for the coffee, though it is good.
You watch it because that's where the rising M-value begins.
